recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-19729; later search-parameter expression concerns should remain under their later Jira issues rather than changing this STU3 audit.
issue_request: FHIR-19729 was Published/Persuasive and asked to fix invalid search parameter FHIRPath expressions for Group value and Observation combo-value-quantity where `as` and `|` operator precedence made the expressions invalid; the resolution was to add parentheses as suggested in Zulip.
initial_application: No FHIR-19729-keyed implementation commit was found. The original application appears to be 005eb62bce088bddc5a6fad83a7978027490a419, merged as PR #352 on 2018-12-06, which parenthesized Group and Observation spreadsheet search expressions matching the Zulip thread.
additional_context: Group and Observation are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and the current source uses bundle-Group-search-params.xml and bundle-Observation-search-params.xml for the checked-in search parameter definitions. Later cleanup, including FHIR-29653 commit ee9191ec79 for Observation and 2023 Group commits 7b140eccee and aac5d575d8, changed relevant expressions from parenthesized `as` forms to `ofType()` forms.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current Group value is `(Group.characteristic.value.ofType(CodeableConcept)) | (Group.characteristic.value.ofType(boolean))`, and current Observation combo-value-quantity is `Observation.value.ofType(Quantity) |  Observation.component.value.ofType(Quantity)`, preserving valid FHIRPath semantics under the later ofType() representation.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Observation issue changed affected Observation `as` expressions to `ofType()`, explaining why the current source no longer literally matches the 2018 parenthesized-`as` fix.
